verdict.rationale: Namecheap publishes first-party SDKs/tooling on GitHub — a Go SDK (go-namecheap-sdk) with documented context-aware methods (CheckWithContext, CreateWithContext, RenewWithContext, SetRegistrarLockWithContext, GetTldListWithContext) and an official Terraform provider for DNS — giving developers real official libraries to build against beyond raw XML API calls. However, the core API itself is a legacy XML-based interface (api.namecheap.com/xml.response) with no evidence of broader official SDKs (Python, JS/TS, etc.) or modern REST/JSON support, and there is no independent corroboration of SDK quality or adoption. Missing for 10: multi-language official SDK coverage, modern API format, independent developer corroboration of SDK reliability.
